lines.text: In 1970, Oregon removed a dead whale... with dynamite.

parts.tts: In nineteen seventy, Oregon removed a dead whale...
parts.heard: In 1970, Oregon removed a dead whale.

lines.text: A 45-foot sperm whale had washed up on the beach in Florence, Oregon.

parts.tts: A forty-five-foot sperm whale had washed up on the beach in Florence, Oregon.
parts.heard: A 45-foot sperm whale had washed up on the beach in Florence, Oregon.

lines.text: 8 tons, rotting, and the state highway department got the job.

parts.tts: eight tons, rotting, and the state highway department got the job.
parts.heard: eight tons rotting, and the state highway department got the job.

lines.text: The plan: blow it to bits, and let the seagulls clean up.

parts.tts: The plan: blow it to bits, and let the seagulls clean up.
parts.heard: the plan, blow it to bits, and let the seagulls clean up.

lines.text: So they used half a ton of dynamite. A crowd gathered to watch.

parts.tts: So they used half a ton of dynamite. A crowd gathered to watch.
parts.heard: So they used half a ton of dynamite, a crowd gathered to watch.

lines.text: But here's the part... the whale came back down.
Chunks of blubber rained on the crowd. One crushed a brand-new car.

parts.tts: Chunks of blubber rained on the crowd. One crushed a brand-new car.
parts.heard: Chunks of blubber rained on the crowd. One crushed a brand new car.

lines.text: Nobody was seriously hurt. The seagulls? Scared off. And most of the whale... was still there.

parts.tts: Nobody was seriously hurt. The seagulls? Scared off. And most of the whale...
parts.heard: nobody was seriously hurt, the seagulls, scared off, and most of the whale...

lines.text: 50 years later, the town named a park after it: Exploding Whale Memorial Park.

parts.tts: fifty years later, the town named a park after it: Exploding Whale Memorial Park.
parts.heard: Fifty years later, the town named a park after it, Exploding Whale Memorial Park.
